_comment: Measured on a throwaway copy of the design on 2026-11-14 (edit + thumbnail test). Locator IDs were IDENTICAL in a second fresh copy (checked 2026-11-14), but still find elements by original text + role (read-design on the new copy) and treat the IDs as a hint. max_chars are approximate and derived from the original text plus one overflow test; always verify with the after-edit thumbnail.

design.title: 2026-09-02 - הסוד הקטן שלמדתי על חנויות שופיפיי שלא מוכרות

behaviors_measured.text_box_autogrows_and_can_overlap_the_p: Slide 3: a 260-char body (the original is 173) grew the box and ran over the photo. Hence the max_chars below.
behaviors_measured.highlight_bars_are_separate_fixed_shapes: Slides 1, 4, 5 have a lime rectangle that does NOT follow the text. After replacing text, re-fit it with resize_element/position_element, verify with the thumbnail (max 3 tries), and if it still looks wrong delete it with delete_element.
behaviors_measured.edit_design_demands_verification: Every edit returns status edits_unverified plus a thumbnail. Compare it before moving to the next page.
